title: Reverse the Digits of a Number
question: Reverse the digits of 1234 using a while loop and print the result.
code:
number = 1234
reversed_number = 0
while number > 0:
    digit = number % 10
    reversed_number = reversed_number * 10 + digit
    number //= 10
print(reversed_number)
explanation: The remainder gives the last digit; repeated multiplication builds the reversed number.
